mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits the conversion of pyridoxine (B6) to its active form pyridoxal-5-phosphate through CYP450 enzyme inhibition, potentially reducing B6 bioavailability and cofactor function.
action: Monitor for signs of B6 deficiency with chronic cimetidine use; consider B6 supplementation or increased dietary intake if prolonged cimetidine therapy is necessary.
